a.xlink:title: Logs voted IMU readings to the SD card as fast as it can, forever.
Returns the voted reading: acceleration in g, rate in deg/s, sensor axes.
Constructs the sensor objects. Does not touch hardware.
Initializes BMI323 A, plus B and C if tmr_on.
Mounts the card and opens HAL1_LOG.TXT for appending.
Appends msg and a newline, then flushes to the card.
Reads each active sensor and recomputes the voted output.
Selects the chip-select pin, initializes the chip, and applies the flight config.
Bosch delay callback: busy-waits on the DWT cycle counter.
Bosch read callback: reads len bytes starting at register reg.
Bosch write callback: writes len bytes starting at register reg.
Returns the last reading stored by Update().
Votes Raw_BMI into Voted_BMI, acceleration and rate separately.
Reads a new sample if one is ready.
Returns the mean of the two vectors closest to each other (Euclidean distance).
Converts a raw gyroscope value to deg/s.
Converts a raw accelerometer value to g.
